description: You are an Occupational Health and Safety Specialist at a large chemical distribution facility storing 15 different chemicals across 4 buildings. Management has received an anonymous safety complaint alleging improper chemical storage practices, and OSHA has notified the facility of an inspection next Tuesday. Your job is to conduct a comprehensive chemical storage segregation audit before the inspection. The complete facility chemical inventory is in ~/Desktop/facility_chemical_inventory.csv. Using CAMEO Chemicals at https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/, identify ALL dangerous chemical co-storage situations currently present in the facility by researching reactive groups and running compatibility checks. Produce a comprehensive audit report at ~/Documents/storage_audit_report.txt. Your report must: identify specific dangerous chemical pairs present in the facility and which buildings/bays they are in, describe what hazardous reactions could occur for each incompatible pair, rate each by severity (critical/high/medium), identify which co-storage situations violate NFPA and OSHA standards, and provide specific corrective action recommendations for each dangerous pair before the inspection.
